component.name: Code Ducky
component.summary: Review your branches and pull requests

description.p: A native code review app for your own branches and the pull requests you are asked to review: split and unified diffs, notes on lines and ranges, viewed state, and review tasks handed to coding agents.
Code Ducky runs on top of herdr-core (hc), which must be running on this machine. Git, files, terminals and other machines are all reached through herdr-core.
